Monday at Spotify Camp Nou. Say less.🏟️

La setmana comença aquí

he came, he conquered 🐐🫡
-
Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football, saying the decision “hurt” but that “the time has come.”

The 39-year-old leaves as Argentina’s all-time leading scorer and most-capped player, having scored 125 goals in 207 appearances and won the 2022 World Cup as Argentina National Team’s captain in Qatar.
-
#messi #9gagnews

and after lunch break 
-
#work #job #memes #9gag

Lionel Messi has announced his decision to retire from international football, revealing that he had actually written his retirement statement on July 21, just two days after Argentina’s defeat to Spain in the FIFA World Cup final in New York. 🇦🇷💔

However, Messi said the recent death of his father, Jorge Messi, made him even more certain about the decision. Jorge passed away on August 8 at the age of 68. Messi wrote that after what happened with his father, he was “even more convinced than before” about his decision.

Messi made his Argentina debut in 2005 and went on to become the country’s all-time leading goalscorer with 125 goals in more than 200 appearances. He represented Argentina at six World Cups, featured in three finals and finally lifted the trophy in Qatar in 2022. 🏆🐐

Hansen Yang just had himself a game! 🔥 

21-year-old star led China to the win over Lebanon 🫡 

#FIBAWC

Wherever Lionel Messi goes, trophies seem to follow!🐐👣

Messi’s career has coincided with some of the
biggest moments in football history! He captained Argentina to their third FIFA World Cup title in 2022, helped Barcelona add four UEFA Champions League trophies during his first-team era, and transformed Inter Miami’s history after arriving in 2023. 🙌🏽

Since joining the club, Inter Miami has lifted the Leagues Cup
(2023), Supporters’ Shield (2024), and MLS Cup & Eastern Conference title (2025), adding another remarkable chapter to Messi’s legacy. 🐐❤️

Whether for club or country, one thing remains constant - winning. Which trophy defines Messi’s legacy the most?🏆

#sarcasm #messi #goat #legend #argentina

10 years ago, Lionel Messi retired from international football with ZERO major honours before reversing his decision two months later.

Since then:

🏆 World Cup
🏆🏆 2x Copa América
🏆 Finalissima

Now he retires having completed football with Argentina 🇦🇷❤️

#sarcasm #messi #argentina #legend #respect

🚨🇦🇷 Full statement by Lionel Messi: “I wrote these words on July 21, two days after the final… today, after what happened with my dad, I’m even more convinced of this decision than before”.

“After all this time since the final, and after thinking about it a lot, I want to tell everyone that I’m retiring from the national team.

“It was a decision that hurt and still hurts deep inside, but I understand that this is the right moment. 

“I swear I always gave everything, not only in these last few years when we won everything, but before that too. I always fought and gave everything for this shirt, to bring you happiness and make you feel proud to be Argentine through football.

“There isn’t much time left, and different chapters are coming to an end. This is one that hurts me a lot. I love, I loved, and I will always love being part of the national team. I gave everything I had, and I don’t have anything more to give. 

“Also, there are great young players coming through who deserve to be here.

“Thank you for all the love during these 20 years. I’m going to miss hearing you from the inside. Now I’ll be one of you, always supporting from the outside, in the good times and even more in the bad ones.

“Thank you to my family for always being there and for being with me throughout this beautiful but difficult journey. Thank you to every coach, teammate and director I had the chance to share it with. I take with me unforgettable memories and moments.

“I leave with peace and pride, knowing that together with my teammates we gave you moments we once dreamed of. It was crazy to experience all of this with you. I love you!

“Thank you God for making me Argentine.

“Vamos Argentina!🇦🇷

#sarcasm #messi #goat #legend #respect

#sarcasm #reels music #singer #viral

In 2006, Lionel Messi stepped onto the World Cup stage with Argentina for the very first time. 🇦🇷✨

Today, he has announced his retirement from international football. The greatest chapter of his career has finally come to an end. 🐐📖❤️

#sarcasm #messi #goat #legend #argentina

A dream debut: coming on in the 75th minute, he scored 1 goal and provided 1 assist. ⚽️🎯

Now, he finishes his international career with 1 World Cup, 2 Copa Americas and a Finalissima title! 🐐

#sarcasm #messi #goat #respect #legend

Infinite thanks, Lionel Andrés Messi.❤️🇦🇷

Once a GOAT, always a GOAT 🐐

#sarcasm #messi #goat #respect #argentina
